reviews.text: Excellent care for my little Gojo. Outstanding professionalism that is reflected in the health of their patients and even in their behavior during their visits. I personally never thought I'd see a cat so calm during vet visits, and here I witnessed it firsthand! Many thanks to all the staff, especially Dr. Minerva and Keny :)
Excellent doctors, always clean clinic and 10/10 service

Excellent doctors.
Good facilities.
They are always attentive.
Excellent service and lots of love for the pets. 🐾❤️ Their dedication, professionalism, and patience are evident. I was very satisfied with the service. I definitely recommend them!
Excellent veterinary clinic. They have a dedicated cat clinic (which is greatly appreciated!), and the doctors are very sweet and empathetic. 🐈‍⬛💕

Super professional, excellent 24-hour service, and very good prices. Whenever I needed to contact the vet who treated my puppy, she answered the phone to continue providing guidance and advice on the treatment. 100% recommended.

I just went because it's the only vet two blocks away due to an emergency. My kitten ate half a grape (they're very toxic to cats, so you understand the urgency). I took her in, and when I arrived, the receptionist (I don't know if she was the vet) told me, "Hello, excuse me, do you have anything to make my cat vomit? She ate a grape." She said no, she needs to come in for a consultation. I said okay, how much is the consultation? She listed her prices, and I said 700. "Okay, can you see her?" she asked. Then she gave me her card to make an appointment. What part of "it's an emergency" didn't she understand? I said, "Then you can't see her?" She said no, because they're about to close. Honestly, I didn't stay to hear what else she said because I had to go find a vet who would see an emergency, and I actually checked, and they still had more than half an hour before closing time.

So, if you have an emergency, I suggest you don't go to this place; they won't see you.

They helped my kitten travel from Guadalajara to Ecuador—it was incredible! They guided us through the entire process, were very attentive to our situation, and helped us with everything we needed! We traveled without any problems, and the kitten was very calm. Thank you to Minerva and her team for making this process so easy! I highly recommend them.
I am very grateful for her service. For a little over a year now, I have been taking my pets to Dr. Minerva, and she has been very accurate with her diagnoses, both for my dog ​​and my kittens.

Excellent experience with MDC Veterinary Center! We needed to process all the paperwork to travel internationally with our dog Bela, and the veterinarian was incredibly thorough. He explained the entire process step by step, made sure all our documents were complete and in order, and was always available to answer any questions.

My experience with MDC was the best; I highly recommend them!
They helped me with the protocols for bringing my pet from Guadalajara to Chicago.
They were always attentive and available to answer any questions I had.
Dr. Minerva was always very attentive and kind.
And her entire team is the best.

What a joy. How lucky were we to find this vets. They are absoultely fantastic. In minutes, our dog was diagnosed and had recommended treatment. Literally minutes, when we had been to three other vets and struggled for over three months. I could have kissed her!
We also dealt with International health certificates which Dr Minerva made so bloody easy. She is diligent, accurate and with her excellent paperwork we had the smoothest airport experience ever.
I cannot recommend MDC vets highly enough. Your little ones are safe in their hands (and so are you).

Excellent service. I went to them to complete the export process for my two cats to Europe, and everything went perfectly. The documentation was very complete and well-prepared, and communication via WhatsApp was always quick and clear. Furthermore, my pets were treated with great respect and affection. The entire process was very professional. I highly recommend them.

I highly recommend this clinic and all its staff. Our dog was about to make his first international trip, and we went to see Dr. Minerva to get his health certificate and update his vaccination record. The doctor was thorough and organized. She patiently and kindly explained our dog's health requirements and made sure everything was in order. The certificate she issued was clear and beautifully presented. Even the airline staff noticed how easy it was to identify all the necessary documents for his entry into the country. Furthermore, the staff made sure no other documents were required and contacted the health authorities to get all the information and save me the expense of obtaining unnecessary certificates. I am very happy with the service we received.

Without a doubt, the staff at MDC are more than excellent. They are not only very caring but also extremely professional with pets (in my case, Amaya, my cat). I highly recommend them because the improvement in my pet's life, thanks to Dr. Minerva's excellent recommendations, has been remarkable. And I congratulate them on their first year in business.
Very accurate! Thanks to MDC, my dog ​​is enjoying her 17th year. Dr. Minerva diagnosed her with a heart murmur, and she's been undergoing treatment ever since. She's still with us ❤️🩷🐶 …

Highly recommended! Thanks to early detection, we knew about Molly's condition before our daughter met her. Thank you, Doctor, for doing everything for her. Excellent care and honesty for our furry friends.

Always excellent service. Rocky, like on other occasions, stayed with us during the Christmas holidays and arrives at MDC happy to be there. When we pick him up, he's always in perfect condition, as if he'd been at home. You can always tell they treat him with a lot of love. I also appreciate that every time we drop him off, they make sure he's up-to-date on his vaccinations and deworming, and that he's healthy in every way. I always leave him at MDC with complete confidence.
